name: Normcore
places: coined by trend forecasting collective K-HOLE (2013)

media.title: K-HOLE, "Youth Mode" report (2013)
media.note: the trend-forecasting document that coined the term

reacts_against: hypebeast logomania and curated individuality-as-brand; normcore's joke/thesis was that true confidence looks deliberately unremarkable.
